description:
Run background checks on your candidates without leaving Bubble. Checkr is a modern, API-driven background screening service used by thousands of marketplaces, gig platforms and employers. This plugin wraps the screening workflow into Bubble data calls and actions: create the candidate, order the report, then pull results back as they complete — ready to gate onboarding, approve a driver or unlock a listing automatically.

Key Features:
🧑 Candidates: Create a candidate record from your own signup or onboarding flow.

📋 Reports: Order a report against any package and retrieve it as screening finishes.

📦 Packages: List the screening packages configured on your Checkr account and let users or admins choose one.

🔍 Individual Screenings: Retrieve SSN Trace, National Criminal Search, Motor Vehicle Report, Sex Offender Registry and Global Watchlist results individually for granular decisions.

⚙️ Automation Ready: Results arrive as native Bubble data, so approval, rejection and follow-up can all be workflow-driven.

Plugin documentation: https://docs.inova.us/v1/checkr-plugin

Plugin support: https://inova.us/support
name: checkr
plugin_instructions:
1- Once your Checkr account has been created, your API keys will be available in the Checkr Dashboard, in the Account Settings > Developer Settings

2- Use your API key as the username and an empty password
